using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogError_Called_When_Exception_Occurs()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new MigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            try
            {
                // Simulate an exception occurring
                throw new Exception("Test exception");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                migrateSession.LogError(ex, "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}", nameof(CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync), StoreType.Main, 0, 0, 0);
            }

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
